homepageTopArticles.title: Marketplace Briefing: Why Amazon is selling its AI-powered shopping tools to other retailers
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Amazon is starting to sell the technology behind its AI shopping assistant to other retailers, as the e-commerce giant looks to become a bigger player in the fast-growing market for AI-powered shopping tools.

homepageTopArticles.title: Amazon fulfillment competitor Stord raises $250M at $3B valuation
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Stord offers a network of physical warehouses and inventory management software for e-commerce. It bills itself as a sort of anti-Amazon, giving brands "the speed to compete" while still owning their customer relationships.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: AI-generated summary: Stord, an ecommerce fulfillment company positioning itself as an alternative to Amazon by providing a network of warehouses and inventory management software, has raised $250 million at a $3 billion valuation. The company aims to help brands compete quickly while maintaining ownership of their customer relationships.

homepageTopArticles.title: Richemont reports strong jewellery sales, dismisses brand sale speculation
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Richemont has reported a significant increase in sales across its jewellery brands over the past financial year, countering a decline in revenue from watch brands.
